mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, discretionary retail trips will keep thinning out and RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not recover from their current depressed levels.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week drop in TRANSIT below its prior two-week average by more than 2 points will reduce access to shopping districts and pull RETAIL_REC down within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within two weeks after a clear TRANSIT decline of more than 2 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS rises while WORKPLACES stays weak, more trips shift to outdoor leisure rather than commercial shopping, so RETAIL_REC will fall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over four weeks even though PARKS remains elevated and WORKPLACES remains below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL climbs above 5 percent and WORKPLACES remains below -30 percent, a renewed stay-at-home pattern will suppress shopping trips and push RETAIL_REC lower within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 5 while WORKPLACES stays below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next month after RESIDENTIAL exceeds 5 and WORKPLACES remains below -30 for at least one week.

mechanism_narrative: In a stable winter-like regime, a rise in GROCERY_PHARM together with flat or falling TRANSIT signals more essential-trip substitution than discretionary shopping, which keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken within two weeks when GROCERY_PHARM rises and TRANSIT remains flat or declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PARKS mobility crowds out mall and high-street visits; if PARKS is above its previous week again, RETAIL_REC will be lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains above its prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not drop in the following week after PARKS posts another week of above-prior-week gains.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both recover from their current lows, commuting-linked shopping should rebound and RETAIL_REC will be higher over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES each rise for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its prior 4-week mean despite two consecutive weeks of recovery in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: In a restrictions-tightening regime, continued weakness in TRANSIT combined with elevated RESIDENTIAL keeps retail access constrained, so RETAIL_REC will remain below its recent average over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks while TRANSIT stays depressed and RESIDENTIAL remains elevated.
